i.content:
import argparse, os, psycopg

SQL = """
UPDATE bookings SET fare_cents = ROUND(fare_decimal * 100)::bigint
WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM bookings WHERE id > %s AND fare_cents IS NULL
             AND fare_decimal IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT %s)
RETURNING id
"""

def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument('--commit', action='store_true')
    p.add_argument('--batch', type=int, default=2000)
    a = p.parse_args()
    last, total = 0, 0
    with psycopg.connect(os.environ['DSN']) as conn:
        while True:
            with conn.transaction():
                ids = [r[0] for r in conn.execute(SQL, (last, a.batch))]
                if not ids:
                    break
                last, total = max(ids), total + len(ids)
                print(f'batch up to id={last} total={total}')
                if not a.commit:
                    conn.rollback(); break
    print(('updated' if a.commit else 'would update (first batch only)'), total)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
